items.title: Nano Banana image generation comes to Google Earth
items.excerpt: Google has integrated its Nano Banana image-generation model into Google Earth, letting users generate photorealistic renderings of historical sites (e.g. 'Pompeii in 78 AD') and pre-visualize future construction projects directly on the map. A concrete push of generative image AI into spatial design, architectural visualization, and place-based concept rendering workflows.
